AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

2. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

3. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. D — newton (N)

5. C — Producers

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.

11. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Management of Agro- byproducts; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Agri- business Accounts; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Inorganic fertilisers; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Water conservation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
